matching: same original task directory; nearest frame length; tie by source episode index
frame_policy: 16 uniformly spaced frame positions including first and last, floor(k*(N-1)/15) for k=0..15
camera_policy: same 16 indices in all three views
crop_policy: same fixed normalized center ROI per camera and class; supplementary to full view
label_use: outcomes/categories used only to balance pilot case selection, never select frames/crops/offsets
